'''2021 Online Championship Series Playoffs''' was the Players Committee OCS playoff on GEMP, October–November 2021. [[Matthew Harrison-Trainor]] won, defeating [[Justin Branch]] in the Finals.<ref name="pc">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2021-online-championship-series-wrap-mht-victorious/ 2021 Online Championship Series Wrap - MHT victorious], starwarsccg.org (29 November 2021). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022202942/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2021-online-championship-series-wrap-mht-victorious.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Open]]
* '''Site:''' GEMP
* '''Dates:''' October–November 2021
* '''GEMP importable decks:''' [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewforum.php?f=1240 forum]

== Early-season qualifiers ==

During the six-month regular season, known qualifier spots from the first half of the season included:<ref name="slack-ocs21-qual">Star Wars CCG Slack, #announcements, Players Committee Twitter feed (@swccg), 1 April and 1 June 2021: “The March OCS Qualifier is done! & the 2 players who earned playoff spots are none other than the 2020 winner & the 2020 runner-up- allstarz97 & pmyers! ... 54 (!) players hit the max 12 games in March.” (1 April 2021); “2021 Online Championship Series Update: Month 3 of 6 & Season 1/2 have wrapped up. gavino1983 & GoldenGod go 11-1 & take the May spots. MatthewHT & arebelspy each get Season 1 at-large bids. Previously-qualified pmyers goes 12-0. arebelspy joins zlorfik as only 4x OCS quals.” (1 June 2021).</ref>
* '''March:''' [[Justin Desai]], [[Paul Myers]] (54 players played the maximum 12 games in March)
* '''May:''' "gavino1983" (11–1), [[Charlie Arlandson]] (11–1); Myers finished May 12–0
* '''Season 1 at-large bids:''' [[Matthew Harrison-Trainor]], [[Joe Olson]] (Olson joined [[Bastian Winkelhaus]] as the only four-time OCS qualifiers)

== Top 16 seeds ==

Top 16 seeds announced on 1 October 2021 (with career OCS playoff appearance counts where noted; two GEMP handles have no identified player page):<ref name="slack-ocs21-play">Star Wars CCG Slack, #announcements, Jared Napolitano (JaredNap), James Martin (solidsnck), jarjardrinks, and Players Committee Twitter feed (@swccg), 1 October – 25 November 2021: Top 16 seed list (1 pmyers-2, 2 zlorfik-4, 3 MatthewHT, 4 dillen, 5 allstarz97-3, 6 Bkippel-2, 7 jokerking, 8 CoffeePass-2, 9 wirfs-3, 10 stubbly-2, 11 gavino1983-2, 12 arebelspy-4, 13 GoldenGod-2, 14 Silverglen-4, 15 retwin316-2, 16 tom-3); Round of 16 matches (Paul Myers def. Chris Wirfs after +8 Game 1; Justin Desai def. Conor Britain after +17 Game 1; Bastian Winkelhaus vs. Joe Olson); Quarterfinals (Charlie Arlandson vs. Bastian Winkelhaus; Chris Hull vs. Justin Desai; Matthew Harrison-Trainor vs. Drew Lichtenstein, +10 Game 1; Justin Branch vs. Paul Myers); Semifinals (Charlie Arlandson vs. Matthew Harrison-Trainor starting 20 November; Chris Hull vs. Justin Branch, 22–23 November); Finals (Matthew Harrison-Trainor vs. Justin Branch, 25 November).</ref>

== Discrepancies ==

* '''Seeding:''' The 1 October 2021 Top 16 seed announcement listed [[Conor Britain]] as #10 and [[Justin Branch]] as #14,<ref name="slack-ocs21-play" /> whereas subsequent Players Committee stream announcements billed Britain as #13 in the Round of 16 and Branch as #9 in the Finals.<ref name="slack-ocs21-streams">Star Wars CCG Slack, #announcements, James Martin (solidsnck) via Players Committee Twitter feed (@swccg), 31 October 2021 (“#5. Justin Desai and #13 Conor Britain”) and Jared Napolitano (JaredNap) via Players Committee Twitter feed (@swccg), 25 November 2021 (“3. Matthew Harrison-Trainor and 9. Justin Branch”).</ref>
